limits: One frozen invocation per synthetic project; no repeated-run stability or confidence interval is established.
Twelve newly authored fixtures share shell/CSS and are not independent customer sites or a population sample.
The independent reviewer is AI, not a recruited human usability tester or an external adjudication panel.
All supported judgments concern supplied literal source copy only; they do not prove rendering, image semantics, backend execution, security, human acceptance, or payment.
No implementation or corpus edits, provider calls, browser operations, payment operations, deployment or submission were performed in this review.
Corpus and implementation were frozen before execution. Any subsequent fix and replay of this corpus must be labelled a regression run rather than a new holdout.
